name: DA-Code
description: DA-Code is a code generation benchmark designed to assess LLMs on agent-based data science tasks involving complex data wrangling and analytics using Python and SQL. It features real and diverse data and a controllable executable environment aligned with real-world scenarios.
reputation: A new benchmark introduced in 2024 that is not yet widely adopted, but it targets realistic agentic data-science coding tasks.
notes: Benchmark includes complex data science programming tasks requiring advanced coding skills; baseline achieves only 30.5% accuracy indicating room for improvement.
